payload.summary: ElevenLabs agents are managed as code with the ElevenLabs CLI from elevenlabs/
steps: Edit elevenlabs/agent_configs/<agent>.json, then run `elevenlabs agents push --dry-run` and `elevenlabs agents push` from elevenlabs/
agents.json maps each config file to its live agent ID; ELEVENLABS_AGENT_ID in the environment selects which agent the API mints tokens for
Pull dashboard edits back with `elevenlabs agents pull --update` so the configs stay the source of truth
notes: CLI 1.8.0: `elevenlabs agents add --dry-run` still creates the agent on ElevenLabs and writes agents.json; it is not a preview
Agents require auth (platform_settings.auth.enable_auth) and allow overrides only for the system prompt and first message

The OpenRouter key must be an ElevenLabs workspace secret referenced from conversation_config.agent.prompt.custom_llm.api_key.secret_id; the workspace also holds unrelated secrets, so never bulk-edit or delete secrets

searchText: elevenlabs cli agents push config agent id custom llm openrouter secret
